_comment: Shape-prior experiment. Single-variable change from lizard_heatmap_baseline.json: variant heatmap -> heatmap_shape (projects decoded coordinates onto a point-distribution model) plus the shape_* keys. Everything else is identical, so the A/B is clean. Recipe matches the established ~6.5px lizard heatmap setup (120 epochs, [80,105], batch 32, sigma 5.0, head LR 1e-3). PREREQUISITE: generate the basis first with `python -m landmarking.scripts.shape_bound_report --config landmarking/config/defaults/lizard.json --by-class --save-basis runs/lizard/shape_bound/shape_basis.npz`. shape_components=8 sits between the measured oracle bound at k=6 (2.6px finger / 2.1px toe) and k=9 (1.4 / 1.2), against ~6.5px unconstrained.
